title: Lesson 39 - If Everything Goes to Plan

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: If everything goes to plan, we'll run the rehearsal Friday from two to four in the side gallery.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: What has to happen before we go ahead?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: The portable printer has to arrive by Thursday at five, and the gallery has to remain free. As soon as the printer arrives, I'll test one sample card and send you a photo of the result.

lines.speaker: Owen
lines.text: What are you using for the rehearsal? None of the unapproved photographs, right?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Right. We'll use three photos I took myself and blank cards with invented names. Unless we have the right permissions, candidate material stays out of the room.

lines.speaker: Owen
lines.text: Good. If the printer works, what will each person test?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Daniel will check image size, I'll time the setup, and Aisha will review whether the sample cards are easy to read. You can test the visitor route when you arrive at three.

lines.speaker: Owen
lines.text: That's specific enough. What could still change?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: The delivery window is the main risk. If the printer doesn't arrive by five Thursday, we'll switch to Plan B.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Our backup plan is to rehearse the layout with plain paper at the same time. We'll test the wall positions, timing and visitor route, then test print quality next week.

lines.speaker: Owen
lines.text: So the whole rehearsal isn't canceled because one tool is late.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Exactly. We only postpone the printing step. Either way, the room, start time and permission boundary stay the same.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: What if the gallery becomes unavailable?

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Then we won't move the materials somewhere unsuitable. I'll contact everyone by noon Friday, and we'll choose a new date.

lines.speaker: Owen
lines.text: That gives us two different decisions: printer late means Plan B; room unavailable means postpone.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I'll put that in the update. If people know the trigger, they won't have to guess which plan we're following.

lines.speaker: Lena
lines.text: Good. As soon as I receive either confirmation, I'll update the shared note. Until then, Friday is planned, not guaranteed.
